game_title: Split Join Assembly – Icefall Ladder Defense
game_concept: A tower defense set in Frost Peaks – Icefall Ladder, ladders up an icefall: the avalanche scout must handle crevasse ghouls while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Split Join Assembly: Split sentences into words and join them back to assemble orders.
theme: Frost Peaks – Icefall Ladder: ladders up an icefall
core_gameplay_loop: In Icefall Ladder, repeat each round: Split sentences into words and join them back to assemble orders. Each round, crevasse ghouls strike the flag pole, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the assembly value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the flag pole from crevasse ghouls in Icefall Ladder: keep the assembly meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 30-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: assembly drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 30-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 1 (intro tier): Split Join Assembly
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Split Join Assembly' (Week 8 slot 4), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Icefall Ladder'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how assembly changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against crevasse ghouls in Icefall Ladder.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 30 seconds while assembly > 0.
